questions.q_en:
60. In a certain code language, ‘we can follow’ is coded as ‘218’, ‘follow the rules’ is coded

as ‘589’, and ‘check the list’ is coded as ‘475’. What is the code for the word ‘rules’ in that language?
questions.q_hi: 60. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, 'we can follow' को '218' के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है, 'follow the Rules' को '589' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, और 'check the list' को '475' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। उस भाषा में 'rules' शब्द के लिए कूट क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
60.(a)

From ‘we can follow’ = ‘218’, and ‘follow the rules’ = ‘589’,

we get ‘follow’ = 8 From ‘follow the rules’ = ‘589’ and

‘check the list’ = ‘475’, we get ‘the’ = 5

So on comparing the obtained codes with ‘follow the rules’ = ‘589’,

we get code for ‘rules’⇒  9
questions.solution_hi:
60.(a)

'We can follow' = '218', और 'follow the rules' से = '589'

हम पाते हैं 'follow' = 8 'follow the rules’ से = '589' और

'check the list' = '475', हमें मिलता है 'the' = 5

अतः प्राप्त कूटों की तुलना ‘follow the rules’ से करने पर, = '589'

हमें 'rules' के लिए कोड मिलता है ⇒ 9
